title: Customer-Specific Knowledge Profiles
description: Enable AI to personalize tribal knowledge per shop/customer. Learn shop-specific preferences, material expertise, machine configurations, and job history patterns. JM Die is the canonical test case.

units.title: CustomerKnowledgeProfile Engine
units.description: Core engine for managing customer-specific knowledge profiles with material expertise, machine preferences, and learned modifiers.

units.title: Shop-Specific Modifier Learning
units.description: Learn and apply shop-specific modifiers to tribal knowledge based on observed patterns and preferences.

units.title: Job History Relevance Boosting
units.description: Boost tip relevance based on job history patterns. Tips that worked well for similar past jobs get higher scores.

units.title: Profile-Based Search & Filtering
units.description: Customize tribal knowledge search based on customer profile. Surface relevant tips first, hide irrelevant ones.

summary.ai_integration: Complete customer profile system enabling per-shop personalization, modifier learning from job outcomes, history-based relevance boosting, and profile-aware search/filtering. JM Die used as canonical test case.
